name: nextsaas/product-control
title: Product control
description: Access and control principles in a four-card grid.

default.heading: Choose who’s in.
default.body: Keep members, guests, and responsibilities clear. Make access an intentional choice.

default.heading: Keep the full story.
default.body: Follow decisions and changes with their context, not just a stream of notifications.

default.heading: Bring your tools.
default.body: Plan connections around the files, calendar, and workflows your team already uses.

default.heading: Stay in control.
default.body: Build around portable records and practical exports. Your work should remain yours.

note.default: Product capabilities are illustrative. Confirm availability, integration support, and access rules before publishing.
